moments.text: Infrared sensor view of a pale grey sky: a horizontal line of about ten small bright dots sits left of the crosshair, drifting slowly up and right.
The view jumps wider and the edges darken. The line of dots, now shorter, sits just above the crosshair and drifts toward the upper right.
A cyan square opens on the crosshair and grows, then becomes flashing corner brackets while the line of dots slides out to the upper left.
The line of dots keeps wandering around the crosshair, left, right, above and below, as the sensor follows it.
A bright band appears along the top edge with darker horizontal bands below it; the line of dots stays just left of the crosshair.
